findings.span: reduction of Corynebacterium xerosis in 10 minutes
findings.message: A kill-rate on a named bacterium is an anti-bacterial claim in effect (DEC-01 keeps these flagged); it is in-vitro and the footnote says so. Needs legal sign-off.
findings.fix: Remove it, or attach the study file for review.

findings.message: A time-bound result needs a study of that duration, with the qualifier shown on the creative.
findings.fix: Keep the timeframe only if it comes from a study you can cite, and put the qualifier in the footnote (e.g. '*Consumer perception study, 4 weeks'). Otherwise remove the timeframe.
findings.note: Wording appears on the product page (F12). Severity lowered one step: the brand has published it, but a reviewer must still confirm substantiation is on file.
